citations.quote: The concept behind the liquidity-adjusted VaR is simple.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Traditional VaR prices only return risk and assumes you exit at the midprice. LVaR adds a liquidation-cost term built from the bid-ask spread, then exposes a feedback loop: rising volatility lifts measured VaR, forcing risk-limit selling that depresses prices and raises VaR again.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Liquidity-Adjusted VaR: Splitting Out the Liquidation Cost
